sections.heading: Unified Calendar 058
paragraphs: The great war involving the Zentradi fleet, the Jovian Federation and invaders from outer space ends. It is later called the First Defense War.
Earth makes peace with the Zentradi.
The Hot-Blooded Coup erupts in the Jovian Federation. Its leader, Vice Admiral Kusakabe, goes missing, and young peace advocates take over.
This brings peace between Earth and the Jovian Federation. With the Zentradi, the three form one government, the Earth Federation.
Zentradi naturalization program begins, with micronization for any who wish.
Work begins on the Hisago Plan, a transport-route program to build a Boson Jump network across the solar system.
The Earth Federation puts economic sanctions on anti-Federation colonies and the former Giganos Empire.

sections.heading: Unified Calendar 059
paragraphs: Megaroad-01, the first super-long-range emigration fleet, departs. Macross City is founded, with the retired Macross kept there as a symbol of peace.
The Earth Federation builds Sweetwater to house First Defense War refugees.
Poor support for resettlement on Earth leads to riots by Zentradi immigrants.
After postwar cleanup, the Earth Federation starts reorganizing its military. Londo Bell is formed as an auxiliary force to keep order in the Earth Sphere.
Project Super Nova begins, to select the next-generation Valkyrie.

sections.heading: Unified Calendar 060
paragraphs: The battleship Nadesico B enters service.
A small meteorite on an untraced path falls to Earth. Unidentified life forms emerge from it, and their attacks cause growing damage in many regions.
The Earth Federation orders its military to handle the crisis. Londo Bell forms a special investigation team.

sections.heading: January of the Same Year
paragraphs: One of the largest meteorites on record strikes Saint Cruz.
